title: Quantity Precedes Quality: Supply Protocols and Global Departures
summary: President Hughes updates logistics following a shift in pandemic purchasing rules, authorizing daily essential shopping while strictly preserving the emergency 14-day food and water supply. He praises the immediate impact of online finding, noting that 'quantity precedes quality' when mastering new digital ministering tools. Finally, he confirms the safe return and isolation of North American and international missionaries, encouraging those remaining to use their time intentionally during this great mission test.
